title: Art Finance Advisory
h1: Art Finance Advisory (search-result page title; actual H1 tag not confirmed by any snippet)
summary: Service page of Silver Oak Capital (UK finance brokerage, 91 Wimpole Street, London W1G 0EE) presenting art-backed lending advisory: using fine art, paintings or sculptures as security to raise liquidity while the owner keeps the works. Search summaries state that lenders weigh independent valuation, rarity/provenance, condition, authenticity and liquidity/saleability; that single high-value pieces are generally preferred over portfolios of smaller items; that art supports lower loan-to-value ratios than other asset-backed lending, with an FAQ figure of typically 30% to 60% LTV depending on collection quality, value and liquidity; that lenders monitor value and may request additional security if values fall; and that borrowers can be private collectors, family offices and galleries. The page sits in the site's 'Luxury Asset Finance' navigation group alongside jewellery finance and classic car loans. No fees, rates, loan sizes, durations, lender names, process steps, case studies or testimonials for this page were revealed. Query (c) returned only unrelated industry sources (no Silver Oak content).
